content_patterns: Master toggle with supporting subtitle ('Track your spending limits') gating the budgeting feature. Uppercase, letter-spaced section labels (BUDGET RESET DATE, TOTAL MONTHLY BUDGET, CATEGORY BUDGETS). Money formatted Indonesian-style with dot separators and 'Rp' prefix. Computed feedback in green ('Unallocated Budget: Rp 1.500.000'). Per-category rows show name + amount with inline edit (pencil) and delete (trash) actions. Dashed-outline '+ Add' affordance for list extension. Verb-first CTA: 'Save Changes'.
notable_interactions: Toggle implies feature on/off switch that likely enables/disables the budget sections below. Date input with calendar icon implies a picker. Pencil icons imply inline editing of category budgets; trash icons imply deletion. Dashed 'Add Category Budget' implies opening an add flow. 'Save Changes' implies staged edits committed on tap. Back arrow implies return to Settings.
